title: A deep convolutional neural network for segmentation of whole-slide pathology images identifies novel tumour cell-perivascular niche interactions that are associated with poor survival in glioblastoma
summary: The primary study uses a deep CNN to segment glioblastoma histologic regions on whole-slide images, then integrates regional expression and single-cell evidence to report spatial tumor–vascular/perivascular biology associated with survival. The associations are exploratory and not causal. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Author-repository primary full text, Methods and Results: seven histologic regions from TCGA slides, matched RNA-seq and supporting scRNA-seq from three resections; source reports mutation-stratified survival correlations and cell-type signatures.
